title: Her parents emigrated from India in 1960. In 2026, Forbes named her one of the world's top innovators at 59.

sources.text: American Bazaar - Seven Indian American women on Forbes 50 Over 50 list
Forbes Portugal - 50 Over 50: As mulheres de maior relevo no mundo em inovacao

caption:
Her parents emigrated from India in 1960. In 2026, Forbes named her one of the world's top innovators at 59.

Produced with Mika Brzezinski's Know Your Value initiative, the sixth annual list honours 200 women across four categories - Ajmera featured among the Innovation honourees.

From 1993 to 2011, she founded and led the Global Fund for Children, directing private philanthropic capital to community-based organizations supporting vulnerable children and youth worldwide, before becoming President and CEO of the Society for Science & the Public.

Ajmera's path - from a neuroscience degree to running a century-old science publication - shows a second-generation Indian American reaching the top of a field entirely removed from her parents' own careers.
